You can tell this game was made for the reason people used to make games. It doesnt have the traditional money-grab tactics that a lot of modern games have. Its simple, straightforward, and yet exciting gameplay shows that the creators were passionate about this project and wanted to make something fun. Not something that would just turn a profit for shareholders. I hope this game reminds those in the industry why they joined in the first place. Until then, I'll be working on my base and catching more pals.

Oh, I suppose gameplay is fun too. If you are having base/resource issues, you probably have no idea how to optimize your base. I didn't. But there is some good news! The internet is full of savants pumping out guides for inexperienced slavers like us! For the LOW, LOW price of FREE, you can learn all you need to know and more from the mystical land of the interwebs! 
So I did, then fixed my base, now I puke resources. Need money? I sell my resource puke. Absolutely lovely!

This game is 1,000,000x better than ANYTHING that has come from Pokemon in...well, forever....I am serious, I just finally got around to playing Scarlet a week before Palworld came out and it was a disgraceful POS of a game to be released, yet there are still Pokemon stans that will leap to defend the series. I had more fun within the first couple hours of playing Palworld(and still continue to have loads of fun 70+hrs playing)than what I had in my entire 50hr hellish experience with Scarlet. How the hell is this game so much better than anything that has come out of the Pokemon franchise?!
This is what the older generation of Pokemon players have wanted for years.
